data.title: seriesLFT panics (mat dimension mismatch) when either side has zero inputs/outputs
data.body:
Audit group 1 (connect.go). Checklist cat 3 (panic on well-typed input).

connect.go:691 (seriesLFT): `D := mat.NewDense(max(p,1), max(m,1), nil)` then `D.Mul(s2.D, s1.D)`. When p2==0 or m1==0, s2.D/s1.D are &mat.Dense{} (0x0) while D is 1x1 -> gonum panics "mat: dimension mismatch". seriesSimple (line 82) already uses `mulDims(p, m, sys2.D, sys1.D)` correctly.

Repro (origin/main):
  p, _ := New(A=[-1], B=[1], C=[1], D=[0], 0); p.InputDelay = []float64{0.5}
  cl, _ := Feedback(p, nil, -1)                 // has internal delay -> LFT path
  s2, _ := New([-1], [1], &mat.Dense{}, &mat.Dense{}, 0)   // p=0
  Series(cl, s2)  // PANIC mat: dimension mismatch (connect.go:691)
  s0, _ := New([-1], &mat.Dense{}, [1], &mat.Dense{}, 0)   // m=0
  Series(s0, cl)  // same panic
Expected: per 6K4CVZ/PVX7Q5 precedent, never panic: either a valid result or ErrDimensionMismatch when the result is a p×0/0×m static gain gonum cannot store.

Fix: replace D.Mul with mulDims(p, m, s2.D, s1.D) (and audit the max(·,1)+resizeDense pattern in seriesLFT/parallelLFT/BlkDiag/appendInternalDelay for the same hazard, e.g. mulDense into a max(1)-padded block). Add regression tests for Series with LFT + zero-port operands, both orders.

data.title: Margin/DiskMargin/Bandwidth: placeholder values (NaN/0) for 'no crossover', 'unstable', 'DC gain 0/Inf'
data.body:
Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit). About placeholder VALUES in results, not crossing accuracy (JJMA3D/WGI5MI/RPEHOJ/MY3SAU cover accuracy).

File: margin.go

1. MarginResult (13-18): WgFreq/WpFreq are NaN when there is no crossover; GainMargin/PhaseMargin are +Inf as the "none" marker (selectMargin 399-407 seeds m=+Inf, w=NaN).
   Repro (confirmed): Margin(1/(s+10)) -> {GainMargin:+Inf PhaseMargin:+Inf WgFreq:NaN WpFreq:NaN} err=nil.
   NaN frequency is a placeholder for "not applicable". Fix: make absence explicit - e.g. MarginResult with HasGainCrossover/HasPhaseCrossover-free shape such as `Gain *Crossover` / `Phase *Crossover`? (pointer-nil is also banned) -> preferred: return AllMarginResult-style slices (empty = none is a valid full value) or split accessors GainMargin() (float64, float64, error) returning ErrNoCrossover sentinel. Keep MATLAB margin argument shape (sys).
2. DiskMarginResult for an unstable closed loop (unstableDiskMargin, 593-602): Frequency=0 and PeakFreq=0 are placeholders (no peak frequency exists), PeakSensitivity=+Inf. Repro (confirmed): DiskMargin(unstable loop) -> Frequency:0 PeakFreq:0 err=nil. Fix: return a sentinel (ErrUnstable wrapped "DiskMargin: closed loop unstable") or a result type that does not carry frequencies in that case; document.
3. Bandwidth (409-519): returns 0 with nil error when the DC gain is 0, NaN or Inf (line 441-443, also doc lines 415-416), and 0 when the first grid sample is already below threshold (497-499). Repro (confirmed): Bandwidth(1/s, 0) -> 0, nil. 0 is a placeholder for "bandwidth undefined". Fix: sentinel error (e.g. ErrInvalidArgument/new ErrBandwidthUndefined wrapped "Bandwidth: DC gain is infinite") — verify what MATLAB bandwidth returns for these cases before choosing; +Inf for "never drops" can stay if MATLAB parity.
4. Bandwidth dbDrop==0 means "default -3" (419-421): zero-value-as-default is acceptable only because 0 is otherwise invalid; MATLAB shape is bandwidth(sys) / bandwidth(sys,dbdrop) - consider documenting or splitting.
5. MarginResult, AllMarginResult, Margin lack doc comments (field comments exist, type/func docs do not).

data.title: Swallowed numerical failures in margin/norms/lyapunov/hinfsyn helpers (silent NaN/0/zeros)
data.body:
Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit). Static findings (no repro yet unless noted); each silently turns a failure into a plausible value with nil error.

margin.go
- 71-84 sisoEval.at: LFT path `h, _ := evalSISOFreqResponse(...)` drops the error and returns 0; non-LFT path turns evalWithPoleLimit errors into NaN+NaNi. These values flow into AllMargin (337-342) PhaseMargins/GainMargins and Bandwidth magnitudes with nil error. Fix: at(w) (complex128, error), propagate.
- 755-759 rationalLoop.boundaryRoots: p.Roots() error -> returns nil, i.e. "no crossings" -> AllMargin/Bandwidth report none with nil error. Propagate error.
- 507-516 Bandwidth refine closure: sys.Sigma error -> returns 0 (treated as a crossing value). Propagate (closure can capture first error and Bandwidth returns it).
- 678-709 newRationalLoop returns (nil, nil) to mean "no rational form" (internal, but violates the pattern; callers branch on nil). Return a sentinel or a bool-free separate predicate.

norms.go
- 198-200 hsvFromGramians: Dgesvd ok result ignored; unconverged SVD returns garbage HSV with nil error.
- 205-218 eigenvalueHSV: eig.Factorize failure returns make([]float64, n) (all zeros) as HSV. Return an error (ErrSchurFailed wrapped "HSV:").
- 681-685 hinfLowerBound: Poles error -> (0,0) fallback; acceptable as heuristic seed but should be documented or propagated.

hinfsyn.go
- 405-451 maxSVD: Dgesvd failure -> 0, used as gammaLB in hinfsyn_general.go:96-99 (underestimates the lower bound silently). Also duplicates norms.go maxSVDense; merge into one helper returning (float64, error).

lyapunov.go
- 421-422 and 495-496: `k := impl.Dgetc2(...); _ = k` - k>0 signals a perturbed (near-singular) pivot; result is silently a perturbed solution. Return ErrSingularEquation (or surface via scale) when k>0.

loopsens.go
- 65-68 makeIdentityGain: `sys, _ := NewGain(...)` swallows error (also used by generalized.go:242). Return (*System, error).

frequency_pole.go
- 101 poleSpacing: `poles, _ = ...poles(...)` drops error; spacing then defaults to |s| scale. Document or propagate.

data.title: Swallowed errors/failures in connect, canon, balance, conversion_thiran
data.body:
Audit group 1. Checklist cat 2 (no swallowed errors) / cat 1 (garbage result with nil error) / cat 3 (nil deref).

1. connect.go:542 (Append, n==0 path) and connect.go:1144 (BlkDiag, nTotal==0 path): `sys, _ := NewGain(...)` then `sys.Delay = ...`. NewGain errors on invalid Dt (e.g. Dt=-1 or +Inf, which domainMatch/BlkDiag's Dt equality accept since both operands share it) -> nil deref.
   Repro: g := &System{A:&mat.Dense{},B:&mat.Dense{},C:&mat.Dense{},D:mat.NewDense(1,1,[]float64{2}),Dt:-1}
          Append(g, g)  -> PANIC nil pointer dereference
          BlkDiag(g, g) -> PANIC nil pointer dereference
   Fix: check err and return it (or route through buildSystem, which already does).
2. conversion_thiran.go:18-22 (conversionThiranChannel): `gain, err := NewGain(...); if samples > 0 { gain.InputDelay = ... }; return gain, err` uses gain before checking err (nil deref if err). Fix: early-return on err.
3. canon.go:359-365 (characteristicPoly): eig.Factorize failure returns the polynomial s^n silently; canonCompanion then builds a wrong companion form with nil error. Fix: return ([]float64, error) and propagate (wrap ErrSchurFailed or a new eig sentinel).
4. canon.go:261-265 (schurSortByMagnitude): Dtrexc !ok -> `break`, so Canon(CanonModal) Schur fallback returns an unsorted modal form with nil error. Fix: return error and propagate from canonModalSchur.
5. balance.go:147-151 (Balreal): impl.Dgesvd's ok bool is discarded; non-convergence yields garbage HSV/T/Tinv with nil error. Fix: check ok, return wrapped ErrSchurFailed (or a dedicated SVD sentinel).
Borderline (deliberate fallback, keep but document): conversion_least_squares.go:379-381 refineDiscreteResponse returns the best-so-far fit when the GN solve fails; convert_reverse_hold.go:21 d2cZOHFast error falls back to robust path; canonModal eig error falls back to Schur.
Add tests for items 1-2 (Dt=-1 gains); 3-5 are hard to trigger, a code-review fix is enough.

data.title: FRD.Nyquist returns RHPPoles=0 placeholder meaning unknown; RHPZerosCL valid only for stable open loop
data.body:
Checklist 1 (placeholder value meaning "unknown").

frd.go:450-498 `(*FRD).Nyquist()` returns *NyquistResult with RHPPoles left 0 ("cannot be known from frequency data", doc frd.go:468-471) and RHPZerosCL = Encirclements, which is the closed-loop unstable count only when the open loop is stable. The shared NyquistResult (nyquist.go) documents RHPPoles/RHPZerosCL as real counts for (*System).Nyquist, so the FRD result carries fields whose values are placeholders.

Fix options (pick one, MATLAB nyquist(frd) returns only response data):
 a) FRD.Nyquist returns a distinct result type without RHPPoles/RHPZerosCL (Omega, Contour, ContourN, Encirclements), or
 b) take the open-loop unstable pole count as an explicit argument `Nyquist(rhpPoles int)` so both fields are fully determined.
Also: errors at frd.go:475,483 lack sentinels (covered by the FRD %w task). Also empty FRD (nw==0) returns an empty contour with Encirclements 0 (see FRD empty-model task).

data.title: FRD accepts empty/NaN/duplicate-frequency data and returns placeholders (PeakGain Index -1, empty Sigma/Select results); no Validate
data.body:
Checklist 1/3.

- frd.go:45-47 `NewFRD`: len(omega)==0 -> `&FRD{Dt: dt}` (0x0, 0 freqs) nil error.
- frd.go:54 uses sort.Float64sAreSorted -> duplicate frequencies accepted, while SelectFrequencies (frd.go:259) and FRDConcat (frd.go:363) require strictly increasing.
- NewFRD does not reject NaN/Inf response entries; frd.go:307-336 `PeakGain` then returns `{Gain:-Inf, Index:-1}` nil error when no entry compares > -Inf (all NaN).
- frd.go:249-280 `SelectFrequencies(nil/empty)` and `SelectFrequencyRange` with no match return a 0-frequency FRD, nil error.
- frd.go:527-535 `(*FRD).Sigma` nsv==0 -> SigmaResult{nSV:0} nil error; Bode/Nyquist/FreqResponse on a 0-frequency FRD return empty results.
- No `(*FRD).Validate` although doc.go says "Call Validate after direct field edits"; frd.go:202-207 `Dims` indexes Response[0][0] unguarded -> hand-built FRD{Response: [][][]complex128{{}}} panics in Dims.

Repro:
  NewFRD(nil, nil, 0) -> 0x0 nw=0 err=<nil>
  NewFRD({{1}},{{2}}, omega=[1 1]) -> ok err=<nil>
  f2.SelectFrequencyRange(5,6) -> nw=0 err=<nil>; f3.Sigma() -> &{Omega:[] sv:[] nSV:0} err=<nil>
  NewFRD(all NaN) -> ok; PeakGain -> &{Gain:-Inf Frequency:0 Index:-1} err=<nil>

Fix: NewFRD rejects empty omega (ErrInsufficientData), non-strictly-increasing omega (ErrInvalidArgument), and decide on non-finite response (reject with ErrInvalidArgument, or allow and make PeakGain error ErrInsufficientData when no finite gain). SelectFrequencies/SelectFrequencyRange error (ErrInsufficientData) on empty selection. Add `(*FRD).Validate() error` (shape/omega checks) and call it at the top of public FRD methods/functions that index Response.

data.title: frd.go/descriptor.go/eigdecomp.go: errors created without %w although a sentinel exists
data.body:
Checklist 2 (errors.Is cannot match; one swallowed error).

frd.go:
- 475 FRD.Nyquist "SISO only" -> ErrNotSISO; 483 non-finite response -> ErrInvalidArgument.
- 564 FRDMargin "SISO only" -> ErrNotSISO; 568 "need at least 2 frequency points" -> ErrInsufficientData.

descriptor.go:

- 118 generalizedPoles "generalized eigenvalue decomposition failed" -> wrap ErrSchurFailed.
eigdecomp.go:
- 34 decomposeModes delayed system -> wrap ErrDelayUnsupported (reached from public Stabsep/Modsep).

data.title: ErrDimensionMismatch used for non-dimension invalid arguments (EKF, FRD, FreqRespEst, Gram type)
data.body:
Checklist 2 (wrong sentinel; ErrInvalidArgument / ErrOptionUnsupported exist).

- ekf.go:38 nil model, :41 nil function, :44 nil matrix argument -> ErrInvalidArgument (keep ErrDimensionMismatch for :49/:60 sizes).
- frd.go:51 omega negative/Inf/NaN, :55 omega unsorted, :63 omega above Nyquist -> ErrInvalidArgument.
- frd.go:257 index out of range, :260 indices not increasing, :271 min>max, :284 nil mapper, :340/:346 nil FRD, :364 frequency order -> ErrInvalidArgument.
- freqrestest.go:95 unknown method -> ErrInvalidArgument; :98 h2 for MIMO -> ErrOptionUnsupported.

Fix: switch sentinel; update tests that errors.Is(ErrDimensionMismatch) on these paths. Cross-file pattern; other groups own their files.

Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit). About placeholder VALUES in results, not crossing accuracy (JJMA3D/WGI5MI/RPEHOJ/MY3SAU cover accuracy).

File: margin.go

1. MarginResult (13-18): WgFreq/WpFreq are NaN when there is no crossover; GainMargin/PhaseMargin are +Inf as the "none" marker (selectMargin 399-407 seeds m=+Inf, w=NaN).
   Repro (confirmed): Margin(1/(s+10)) -> {GainMargin:+Inf PhaseMargin:+Inf WgFreq:NaN WpFreq:NaN} err=nil.
   NaN frequency is a placeholder for "not applicable". Fix options (no nil pointers, no NaN): (a) Margin returns only crossovers that exist, e.g. separate GainMargin(sys) (gm, wpc float64, err) / PhaseMargin(sys) (pm, wgc float64, err) that return a wrapped ErrNoCrossover sentinel when none; or (b) keep MarginResult but have Margin return ErrNoCrossover when either crossover is missing and point callers at AllMargin (empty slices = none is a valid full value). Keep MATLAB margin(sys) argument shape. Note: +Inf margin with no crossover is MATLAB parity; the NaN frequency is the defect.
2. DiskMarginResult for an unstable closed loop (unstableDiskMargin, 593-602): Frequency=0 and PeakFreq=0 are placeholders (no peak frequency exists), PeakSensitivity=+Inf. Repro (confirmed): DiskMargin(unstable loop) -> Frequency:0 PeakFreq:0 err=nil. Fix: return a wrapped sentinel (ErrUnstable "DiskMargin: closed loop unstable"), or a result shape that does not carry frequencies in that case; document.
3. Bandwidth (409-519): returns 0 with nil error when the DC gain is 0, NaN or Inf (441-443, documented at 415-416), and 0 when the first grid sample is already below threshold (497-499). Repro (confirmed): Bandwidth(1/s, 0) -> 0, nil. 0 is a placeholder for "bandwidth undefined". Fix: wrapped sentinel (e.g. new ErrBandwidthUndefined, "Bandwidth: DC gain is infinite"). Verify MATLAB bandwidth behaviour for these cases before choosing; +Inf for "never drops" can stay if MATLAB parity.
4. Bandwidth dbDrop==0 means "default -3" (419-421): zero-as-default is tolerable only because 0 is otherwise invalid; MATLAB shape is bandwidth(sys) / bandwidth(sys,dbdrop). Document.
5. MarginResult, AllMarginResult, Margin lack doc comments (field comments exist; type/func docs do not).

data.title: Unvalidated scalar/enum args: Feedback sign, Place/Acker non-finite poles, unknown BalredMethod
data.body:
Audit group 1. Checklist cat 1 (garbage/unintended result with nil error), cat 5 (constructors/entry points validating).

1. connect.go Feedback(plant, controller, sign float64, ...): any sign accepted. sign=0 silently returns the open-loop plant; sign=2.5 gives scaled feedback. MATLAB feedback(sys1,sys2,sign) documents sign as +1/-1 only.
   Repro: sys1 = ss(A=[-1 2;0 -3],B=[1;1],C=[1 0],D=0); Feedback(sys1,nil,0) -> plant unchanged, err=nil; Feedback(sys1,nil,2.5) -> A=[1.5 2;2.5 -3], err=nil.
   Fix: reject sign not in {-1,+1} with fmt.Errorf("Feedback: sign %g must be -1 or +1: %w", sign, ErrInvalidArgument) (also in feedbackWithApproximatedDelays path, which recurses into Feedback). Keep the float64 arg (MATLAB shape).
2. controller.go validatePoles (used by Place, Acker): NaN/Inf poles accepted.
   Repro: A=[0 1;-2 -3], B=[0;1]; Acker(A,B,{-Inf,-1}) -> K=[NaN NaN], err=nil. Place(A,B,{NaN,-1}) -> misleading ErrSchurFailed.
   Fix: validatePoles rejects non-finite real/imag parts with ErrInvalidArgument.
3. balance.go Balred/Modred: `if method == Truncate {...}` else SingularPerturbation, so any unknown BalredMethod (e.g. BalredMethod(42)) silently runs singular perturbation.
   Repro: Balred(sys1, 1, BalredMethod(42)) -> err=nil.
   Fix: switch with default -> ErrInvalidArgument.
Tests for each.

data.title: Zero-state (n==0) placeholder results in Balreal, Canon, Place, Acker
data.body:
Audit group 1. Checklist cat 1 (nil/empty placeholder with nil error). Same class as W7OUGJ (Care/Dare/Lqr/Lqe n==0); decide one pattern for both.

- balance.go:40-42 Balreal n==0: returns &BalrealResult{Sys: copy} with HSV, T, Tinv all nil and nil error.
  Repro: g, _ := NewGain([[1]], 0); r, err := Balreal(g) -> err=nil, r.T==nil, r.Tinv==nil, r.HSV==nil.
- canon.go:55-57 and 279-281 Canon n==0: T: &mat.Dense{} (0x0 placeholder) with nil error.

Balred/Modred n==0 can keep returning a copy of sys (that is a fully formed System), but Balreal's T/HSV cannot be fully formed. Update any tests that assert the empty results.

data.title: Group-2 files: bare sentinels without op prefix, double "controlsys:" prefix, inconsistent prefixes, ST1005
data.body:
Checklist 2 (messages prefixed consistently "Op: ...", lowercase).

Bare sentinels returned with no operation context:
- ctrbobsv.go:13,17,43,47,86,90,95,106,110,115,160,164,189,204,208 (Ctrb, Obsv, CtrbF, ObsvF, IsStabilizable, IsDetectable) — plain ErrDimensionMismatch / ErrSchurFailed.
- covar.go:45 Covar ErrUnstable (no "Covar:").
- delay.go:142-149 validateDelayValue ErrNegativeDelay/ErrFractionalDelay (no value/op); :73 SetInternalDelay ErrZeroInternalDelay; :1556,:1559 SetDelayModel.
- descriptor.go:341 properExplicitForm bare ErrImproperModel.
- eigdecomp.go:219 orderSchurGroupFirst bare ErrSchurFailed.
Double package prefix (wrapper adds "controlsys:" before a sentinel that already has it -> "controlsys: singular complex matrix: controlsys: singular matrix in transformation"):
- frequency.go:569,598,891,929 (cSolveInPlace, cInvertInto); descriptor.go:52,118,281,308,324,328,338,359,362; eigdecomp.go:34,41,125,129,165.
Inconsistent op prefixes for the same type: "FRD:", "FRD SelectFrequencies:", "FRD MapResponse:", "frd:", "frd series:", "frd feedback:", "FRDMargin:" (frd.go), vs "EKF.Update:" (ekf.go); NewFRD reports as "FRD:". feedback_lft.go:32 passes "feedback" while feedback_delay.go uses "Feedback".
staticcheck ST1005: delay.go:1565 ("H dimensions ..."), descriptor.go:40 ("E %dx%d ...") capitalized.

Fix: pick one style (suggest "Type.Method:" / "Func:"), add op prefixes at public boundaries, drop the "controlsys:" literal from wrapping messages, lowercase ST1005 strings.

data.title: FreqRespEst fills unidentifiable frequencies with H=0 and coherence 0; FFT method returns nil Coherence and CoherenceAt returns 0
data.body:
Checklist 1 (0 placeholder meaning "unknown"; nil field meaning "unavailable").

- freqrestest.go:225-241 welchSISO: Suu[f] < eps*max(Suu) (and H2 |Syu| tiny) -> `continue`, leaving H[f]=0, coh[f]=0.
- freqrestest.go:339-349 welchMIMO: cInvertInto failure (singular Suu) -> `continue`, H=0 for that frequency. With fewer segments than inputs Suu is rank-deficient at every frequency, so the whole estimate is silently zero.
  Repro: 2-input/1-output, N=64, NFFT=64 (single segment) -> nonzero H = 0 of 66, err=<nil>.
- freqrestest.go:410-412 freqRespEstFFT: |U(f)|<1e-30 -> H=0.
- freqrestest.go:423-427 FFT method leaves Coherence nil; freqrestest.go:46-51 CoherenceAt returns 0 when Coherence is nil. Repro: FFT method -> CoherenceAt(1,0,0)=0, Coherence nil=true, err=<nil>. CoherenceAt also derefs r.H without check.

Fix: (1) Error when the input is not persistently exciting for the requested estimator (e.g. nSeg < m for H1 MIMO -> ErrInsufficientData), and for isolated unidentifiable bins either drop them from Omega/H (documented) or return an error — never 0. (2) Coherence: make it an opt-in request (e.g. opts.Coherence bool) that errors with ErrOptionUnsupported for Method FFT; CoherenceAt must not return a fabricated 0 (return (float64, error) or only exist when computed). MATLAB tfestimate/mscohere are separate functions; consider splitting coherence the same way.

data.title: FreqRespEstOpts zero-value ambiguity and silent clamps (NOverlap=0 unusable, NFFT/NOverlap clamped, Window return ignored)
data.body:
Checklist 5 (zero-value usefulness, silent argument rewriting) and 2 (ignored return).

freqrestest.go:103-135 resolveOpts:
- NOverlap: only `> 0` honoured; 0 means "default nfft/2", so callers cannot request zero overlap; negative silently -> default.
- NFFT <= 0 -> 256 silently; NFFT > N silently clamped to N; NOverlap >= NFFT silently clamped to NFFT-1.
- freqrestest.go:150-157 newFreqRespEstPlan: nSeg<1 silently rewrites nfft=N, noverlap=0.
- freqrestest.go:166 rebuildWindow: `winFunc(p.win)` return value discarded; a user Window that returns a new slice instead of mutating in place is silently ignored (rectangular window used).
- Dead parameters: welchSISO (coeff, strides, winPower), welchMIMO (coeff, winPower, method), freqRespEstFFT (N, winPower) take `_` params.
- FreqRespEstOpts/FreqRespEstMethod/consts/FreqRespEstResult/FreqRespEst/CoherenceAt/FRD undocumented.

Fix (MATLAB tfestimate(x,y,window,noverlap,nfft) semantics): make NOverlap a *int or add an explicit flag so 0 is expressible; reject negative NFFT/NOverlap, NOverlap>=NFFT, NFFT>N with ErrInvalidArgument instead of clamping (or document clamps explicitly); use the returned window slice (validate length == nfft). Drop dead params. Document the options and defaults.

data.title: ConversionResult.InitialStateMap nil means unavailable; make G an opt-in output that errors
data.body:
Audit group 1 (conversion_result.go). Checklist cat 1 (nil field meaning "unavailable" with nil error) — the user rule's exact case: MATLAB optional output ([sysd,G] = c2d(...)) must be an opt-in request that errors when unavailable.

Current behaviour:
- conversion_result.go:10-21 ConversionResult{System, Method, InitialStateMap *mat.Dense, SourceStates, Inputs, DelaySignals, Approximate, Warnings, statesEliminated}. DiscretizeWithResult / D2CWithResult / D2DWithResult leave InitialStateMap nil (nil error) whenever the map is unavailable (matched, least-squares, singular-E reduction, many delay cases, FOH with nt!=n, D2D composition mismatch at :183-203) and only add a free-text Warning.
- conversionStateMap (:240-347) returns (nil, nil) for "unsupported" (lines 244, 310, 344) — internal nil-means-unsupported.
  Repro: sys1.DiscretizeWithResult(0.1, C2DOptions{Method: C2DMethodMatched}) -> err=nil, InitialStateMap==nil, Warnings=["An exact nonzero initial-state mapping is unavailable ..."].
- MapInitialState (:23) on a zero-value ConversionResult nil-derefs r.System (var r ConversionResult; r.MapInitialState(nil,nil,nil) -> PANIC). Exported mutable fields (SourceStates/Inputs/DelaySignals) can be edited out of sync with the unexported statesEliminated invariant.
- MapInitialState treats an empty part slice as zeros (len 0 accepted for any count) — implicit placeholder; acceptable only if documented.
- Undocumented: ConversionResult, MapInitialState, D2DWithResult.

Proposed fix:
- Split responsibilities: C2D/D2C/D2D return *System; the G map becomes an explicit request, e.g. `func (sys *System) C2DMap(dt float64, opts C2DOptions) (*System, *mat.Dense, error)` (MATLAB [sysd,G]=c2d(sysc,Ts,opts)) that returns ErrOptionUnsupported (wrapped with method/reason) when no exact map exists — never a nil matrix with nil error. Same for D2C/D2D.
- conversionStateMap returns (map, error) with a sentinel instead of (nil, nil).
- If Warnings/Approximate stay, keep them as informational only (not as the availability signal); consider typed warning values over free strings.
- Make the result type's invariants unexported or make MapInitialState a method on a type that can't be zero-constructed into a panic.
Update conversion_result_test.go accordingly.

data.title: ConnectByName: Connection.Gain zero value means 1; duplicate connections overwrite
data.body:
Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit). Zero-value placeholder.

File: names.go:339-384.

Current: Connection{From, To, Gain}; `if gain == 0 { gain = 1 }`. A literal Gain:0 is silently turned into unity feedback.
Repro (confirmed): sys 1/(s+1) with names u,y; ConnectByName([sys], [{From:"y",To:"u",Gain:0}], ["u"],["y"]) -> closed-loop A = 0 (i.e. gain 1 applied), not -1.
Also Q.Set(toIdx, fromIdx, gain) overwrites when two connections share (To, From) instead of summing (a summing junction with two identical paths).

Fix: make the zero value meaningful - Gain 0 means zero gain (or reject it with ErrInvalidArgument), and provide a constructor/helper for the common unity case (e.g. Connect("y","u") returns Connection{Gain:1}); or invert the field to an explicit sign/gain with no default substitution. Sum duplicate entries (Q.Set(.., Q.At(..)+gain)) or reject duplicates. Document Connection and ConnectByName (both undocumented), including MATLAB connect analogy.

data.title: GenSig: arguments diverge from MATLAB gensig(type,tau,Tf,Ts)
data.body:
Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit). MATLAB-shaped args rule.

File: gensig.go:8-50.

Current: GenSig(sigType string, period, dt float64) (t, u []float64, err error). Duration is fixed to one period (gridSampleCount(period, dt)); MATLAB gensig(type, tau, Tf, Ts) takes the total duration Tf (default 5*tau) and sample time Ts. "pulse" produces a single sample of height 1/dt at t=0 (u[0]=1/dt) - verify against MATLAB 'pulse' (periodic pulse train) before deciding; current behaviour looks like a discrete impulse, not a periodic pulse.

Fix: GenSig(sigType string, tau, tf, ts float64) matching MATLAB order (tf/ts defaults via options or explicit args), with periodic generation over [0, tf]. Typed signal kind (const enum) would replace the stringly-typed sigType, though a string matches MATLAB; either way validate with ErrInvalidArgument (see sentinel task). Add a doc comment (currently none).

data.title: Balreal/Balred result shape: hsv with error, order-0 magic, aliased slab, unbalanced r==n copy
data.body:
Audit group 1 (balance.go). Checklist cat 1, 4, 5.

1. Balred returns hsv alongside a non-nil error: balance.go:268 `return nil, hsv, err` and :275 `return nil, hsvOut, err` (singularPerturbation also returns hsv with ErrSingularA22 at :426). Bool/value+error double signalling; must be (nil, nil, err).
2. Balred(sys, order int, method): order==0 is a magic "auto-select by largest HSV gap" placeholder. MATLAB balred(sys, orders, opts) has no auto order; HSV come from [rsys,info]=balred / hsvd. Proposal: require 1<=order<=n (ErrInvalidOrder otherwise); expose auto-selection, if wanted, as an explicit helper (e.g. a function returning the suggested order from HSV) rather than a sentinel value. Also consider returning info as a struct (MATLAB info.HSV) instead of a bare []float64.
3. Balred r==n (:252-254) returns policy.zeroOrderCopy() i.e. an unbalanced copy of the input, whereas every other order returns a balanced realization. MATLAB returns the balanced model. Return br.Sys (or document).
4. Aliasing (cat 4): Balreal's alloc helper (:63-67) hands out ws[wi:wi+size] with capacity extending over the rest of the slab; HSV (= s), T, Tinv returned to callers share one backing array, so append(res.HSV, ...) can overwrite unrelated buffers (and, past ~3n² elements, T's data). Use 3-index slices ws[wi:wi+size:wi+size] (same in singularPerturbation take()).
5. BalredMethod zero value (Truncate) serves both Balred (MATLAB default Truncate) and Modred (MATLAB modred default 'MatchDC' = SingularPerturbation); one enum cannot match both MATLAB defaults — document explicitly or use separate option types.
6. Errors: Balreal returns bare ErrUnstable / ErrNotMinimal (:49, :117, :129) without "Balreal:" context; Modred reports index errors as ErrInvalidOrder ("reduction order out of range") — use ErrInvalidArgument with index in message.
7. Docs: BalredMethod, Truncate, SingularPerturbation, BalrealResult undocumented.

data.title: Lyap/DLyap/Gram/ModalTruncate return empty &mat.Dense{} with nil error for n == 0 (W7OUGJ pattern)

Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit). Same pattern as W7OUGJ (Care/Dare/Lqr/Lqe); apply whatever W7OUGJ decides consistently here.

- lyapunov.go:83-85 Lyap and 162-164 DLyap: n==0 -> &mat.Dense{} (gonum's empty, unusable: most mat ops panic on it) with nil error. matrix_equation_problem.go:81-83 lyapunovProblem n==0 shortcut feeds this.

Decide one convention (sentinel error such as ErrInvalidArgument "no states", or documented empty-result contract) and apply across these entry points with doc comments stating it. Not filed: HSV n==0 returning a nil []float64 (zero states -> zero HSVs is a valid full value).

data.title: LqgResult: Ki/Kw/Mx/Mw nil unless the matching option is set (borderline opt-in shape)
data.body:
Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit). Borderline - triage to decide.

File: lqg.go:23-43, 139-147.

Current: LqgResult always has fields K, L, Xc, Xf; Ki is nil unless opts.QI != nil; Kw, Mx, Mw are nil unless opts.Current. Documented in field comments.

Why flagged: rule "never nil fields meaning not applicable". Counter-argument: the option IS the opt-in request (QI selects servo, Current selects current estimator), and requested fields are always filled or an error is returned, which is the shape the user rule asks for.

If tightening: split result shapes by variant (e.g. LqgResult embeds an optional ServoGains struct value + CurrentGains struct value selected by method, or separate Lqg/LqgServo entry points matching MATLAB lqg(sys,QXU,QWV) vs lqg(sys,QXU,QWV,QI)), so no exported field is nil on success. Keep MATLAB argument order.

data.title: Initial/continuousFreeSamples return empty with nil error for p==0

Go error-pattern rule: never return nil/empty placeholder with nil error.
Sites (response.go, main a043481 + #241):
- continuousFreeSamples: `if p == 0 || steps == 0 { return nil, nil }`
- Initial: `if p == 0 { return plan.response(&mat.Dense{}), nil }`

data.title: delayLoop.nyquist reports undetermined Nyquist outcomes as unstable (nil error); errDelayLoopUnsupported unexported and remapped to wrong sentinel
data.body:
Checklist 1 (bool doubling as "unknown") and 2.

delay_nyquist.go:306-375 `(*delayLoop).nyquist` returns `delayNyquist{stable:false}` with nil error on paths that mean "could not decide", not "unstable":
- :332-333 axisOrdersMatch false (may be genuine hidden axis mode -> unstable is defensible, but also triggered by numerical growth-estimate failure).
- :340-342 refine ok=false, which covers (a) 1+L vanishing on the axis (genuine marginal root — unstable OK), (b) :500-501 interval collapse below 1e-13 relative, (c) :503-504 point budget delayNyquistMaxPoints exhausted — resource limit, not instability.
- :369-371 ambiguous winding |turns - round(turns)| > 0.25.
Consumers: margin.go:604-616 diskMarginDelayed -> `unstableDiskMargin` (Alpha 0, PeakSensitivity Inf) with nil error; pid_tuning.go:697 treats candidate as unstable. So DiskMargin can return a confident "unstable" result for a loop the test could not resolve.
Also errDelayLoopUnsupported (delay_nyquist.go:14) is unexported and lacks the "controlsys:" prefix; margin.go:619-623 remaps it to ErrContinuousInternalDelay even for loops with no internal delay (neutral |L(j∞)|>=1, grid > 2^21 points), so the public error is mislabelled. (margin.go owned by another group; root cause is here.)

No direct repro built (needs a loop hitting the point budget or ambiguous winding); paths identified by reading.

Fix: split outcomes — keep stable=false only for proven axis roots / hidden axis modes; return a distinct error (e.g. errDelayLoopUnresolved wrapping ErrDelayUnsupported, or a new exported sentinel) for budget exhaustion, interval collapse and ambiguous winding. Export or map errDelayLoopUnsupported to an accurate public sentinel (ErrDelayUnsupported) and stop remapping to ErrContinuousInternalDelay in margin.go.

data.title: EKF aliases the vector returned by F as filter state and mutates it in Update; Update(nil) panics; exported X/P bypass invariants
data.body:
Checklist 3/4.

- ekf.go:127-142 Predict stores `e.X = xPred` (the slice returned by the user's F). ekf.go:179 Update then does `e.X.AddVec(...)` in place, mutating the user's buffer; next Predict passes that same buffer to F as x.
  Repro: F returns a captured buffer `buf` -> after Predict+Update: X=4.594 buf=4.594 same=true.
- ekf.go:148 Update(nil) -> nil deref panic (z.Len()). Predict does not validate u at all (passed through to F/FJac).
- EKF.X and EKF.P are exported mutable fields; replacing them with wrong-size values makes Predict/Update panic inside gonum (work buffers sized at construction). MATLAB extendedKalmanFilter exposes State/StateCovariance as validated properties.
- ekf.go:97-100 Copy() on nil receiver returns nil (undocumented; doc.go says nil receivers unsupported unless documented).
- Naming vs MATLAB: predict/correct (Go: Predict/Update) — note only.

Fix: copy F's result into e.X (e.X.CopyVec(xPred)) after validation; validate z (nil/len) and document u handling; either unexport X/P behind State()/Covariance() + SetState/SetCovariance that validate dims, or document that callers must keep dimensions and validate at the top of Predict/Update returning ErrDimensionMismatch instead of panicking. Document Copy's nil behaviour or drop it.

data.title: Conversion API shape: Discretize/Undiscretize default Tustin vs MATLAB c2d/d2c ZOH; entry-point sprawl
data.body:
Audit group 1 (convert.go, conversion_options.go, conversion_least_squares.go). Checklist cat 5 (MATLAB-matching args/defaults, API shape).

Current:
- convert.go:10 `Discretize(dt)` uses Tustin; convert.go:41 `Undiscretize()` uses Tustin. MATLAB c2d(sysc,Ts) and d2c(sysd) default to ZOH, and this package's own option path (DiscretizeWithOpts / D2C with Method "") defaults to ZOH (CONTEXT.md: "Zero-order hold is the default discretization method in option-based continuous-to-discrete conversion").
  Repro: sys.Discretize(0.1) and sys.DiscretizeWithOpts(0.1, C2DOptions{}) return different A (Tustin vs ZOH).
- Entry-point sprawl with inconsistent naming: Discretize, DiscretizeZOH, DiscretizeFOH, DiscretizeImpulse, DiscretizeMatched, DiscretizeWithOpts, DiscretizeWithResult, DiscretizeLeastSquares (returns *LeastSquaresResult, different shape), Undiscretize, D2C(method), D2CWithOpts, D2CWithResult, D2D(dt, opts), D2DWithResult. MATLAB has c2d(sys,Ts,method|opts), d2c(sys,method|opts), d2d(sys,Ts,method|opts).
- C2DDelayModelingDelay is an exported alias of C2DDelayModelingInternal (convert.go:183) — two names for one value.
- Zero-value inconsistency: C2DMethod "" -> ZOH, but CanonForm "" -> error (canon.go:40).
- DiscretizeLeastSquares(dt, fitOrder) and C2DOptions.FitOrder use 0 as "auto = source order" placeholder (borderline; acceptable only if MATLAB's FitOrder default is likewise "order of sys" — verify and document).
- Undocumented: Discretize, Undiscretize, C2DOptions, C2DMethod (+consts), C2DDelayModeling (+consts), DiscretizeWithOpts, DiscretizeZOH, DiscretizeFOH, DiscretizeMatched.

Proposed: one MATLAB-shaped trio — `(sys) C2D(dt float64, opts C2DOptions)`, `(sys) D2C(opts D2COptions)`, `(sys) D2D(dt float64, opts C2DOptions)` — zero-value opts = ZOH everywhere; drop or deprecate Discretize/Undiscretize/DiscretizeXXX sugar (or at minimum make Discretize/Undiscretize ZOH and name the Tustin helpers explicitly). Remove the C2DDelayModelingDelay alias. Least-squares stays reachable through C2DOptions{Method: least-squares}; fit diagnostics become an opt-in request (see ConversionResult task 53W2Z7 for the G-map analogue). Breaking change: update tests/examples/README.

data.title: Nil-argument panics in Augstate/Series/Parallel/Append/BlkDiag/Connect/Place/Acker/Lqrd
data.body:
Audit group 1. Checklist cat 3 (panics reachable from public API). Feedback already returns an error for nil plant (connect.go:363), so the package is inconsistent.

Repros (origin/main), all PANIC nil pointer dereference:
- Augstate(nil)                         augstate.go:10
- Series(sys1, nil) / Parallel / Append (domainMatch derefs Dt) connect.go:10
- BlkDiag(g, nil) and BlkDiag(nil)      connect.go:1013/1018 (single-element path calls nil.Copy())
- Connect(sys, nil, []int{0}, []int{0}) connect.go:1238 Q.Dims()
- Place(nil, B, poles), Acker(nil, ...) controller.go:291/198
- Lqrd(A, B, nil, nil, 0.1, nil)        controller.go:107
- (ConversionResult zero value MapInitialState — tracked in 53W2Z7)

Fix: at each exported entry, reject nil *System / *mat.Dense with fmt.Errorf("<Op>: nil <arg>: %w", ErrInvalidArgument) (or ErrDimensionMismatch to match Lqi's "nil weight" — pick one sentinel package-wide; ErrInvalidArgument preferred). Consider one helper (e.g. requireSystems(op, sys...)) rather than ad hoc checks. If the project instead decides nil is a programmer error (panic by contract), document it on each function — but then Feedback/Connect's existing nil checks should go too. Tests for each.

Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit). Rule: sentinels wrapped with %w, consistent "Op: ..." prefix, no fmt.Errorf without a sentinel when one exists. Triage may merge with other groups' equivalents.

No sentinel (errors.Is impossible; confirmed for GenSig/Norm/DiskMarginSkew/Inv):
- gensig.go:10,13,46 -> ErrInvalidArgument
- loopsens.go:16 "controlsys: loopsens: P and C must not be nil" -> "Loopsens: ...: %w" ErrInvalidArgument
- norms.go:40 Norm bad normType -> "Norm: ...: %w" ErrInvalidArgument
- margin.go:551 DiskMarginSkew non-finite skew -> ErrInvalidArgument (prefix should be DiskMarginSkew)
- inv.go:14 delays -> ErrDelayUnsupported
- matlog.go:14, matlog_spectral.go:24 non-square (internal) -> ErrDimensionMismatch
- matutil.go:216-228 invertSmall returns gonum's raw error (mat.Condition) -> wrap ErrSingularTransform; callers in hinfsyn.go:98-107, hinfsyn_general.go:149 pass it out of HinfSyn unwrapped.

Wrong sentinel:
- linearize.go:19,22 nil model / nil F,H -> ErrDimensionMismatch; should be ErrInvalidArgument; prefix "controlsys:" -> "Linearize:".
- local_approx.go:23 nil x0/u0 -> ErrInvalidArgument.
- generalized.go (see XFE4KH), model_array.go dt mismatch -> ErrDomainMismatch (see 7EWB5N).
- lft.go:11,15 nil M / negative nu,ny -> ErrInvalidArgument.

Bare sentinel without op context (message is just "controlsys: dimension mismatch" etc.):
- matrix_equation_problem.go:19-62, 75-85 (all returns) -> callers Lyap/DLyap/Care/Dare get no "Lyap: Q is 3x3, want 2x2" detail.
- lyapunov.go:106,127,185 ErrSchurFailed/ErrSingularEquation; 336,345,431,448,506.
- h2syn.go:37 ErrNoFiniteH2Norm; Care errors returned unwrapped (53,68).
- hinfsyn.go:72,139,194,234,271,277,310-350; hinfsyn_general.go:29-38,158-200,239,295.
- modal_reduction.go:45,62,134,153.
- gramian.go bad GramType (via gramianInputs) -> "controlsys: dimension mismatch".
Fix: wrap with fmt.Errorf("Lyap: ...: %w", Err...) at the public entry points (or pass an op name into the problem constructors).

Inconsistent prefixes (lowercase / non-identifier):
- lft.go "lft:" (11-33,182) -> "LFT:"
- names.go:251,256 "select:" -> "SelectByIndex:"; 330,334 "select inputs/outputs:" -> "SelectByName:"; 348-370 "connectbyname" -> "ConnectByName:"
- loopsens.go:31-59 "controlsys: loopsens ..." -> "Loopsens:"
- generalized.go:24 "fixed system block is nil" (no prefix)
- names.go:65 lookupSignalIndex "%q: %w" (no prefix; callers add one inconsistently)

Related: K5MF76 (group-wide ErrDimensionMismatch misuse, also lists Gram type) and OHCIZR (group-2 bare sentinels); merge at triage.

Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit).

File: gramian.go:61-76 (GramResult.L), gramian.go:46 (n==0).

Current: Gram(sys, typ) always returns GramResult{X, L}. L is set only when Dpotrf succeeds; for a stable but uncontrollable/unobservable model (X semidefinite) L is nil and err is nil. n==0 returns X=&mat.Dense{}, L=nil.

Repro (confirmed in scratch copy):
  s := NewFromSlices(2,1,1, A=diag(-1,-2), B=[1;0], C=[1 1], D=0, 0)
  r, err := Gram(s, GramControllability)  // err=nil, r.L==nil

Violates: "every return is a fully formed value or a non-nil error; no nil fields meaning unavailable". MATLAB makes the factor an explicit request: gram(sys,'c'|'o'|'cf'|'of').

Proposed fix (MATLAB-shaped args):
- Drop GramResult.L from the default result; Gram(sys, GramControllability|GramObservability) returns X only (or GramResult{X}).
- Add GramType values GramControllabilityFactor / GramObservabilityFactor (MATLAB 'cf'/'of'); those return the Cholesky factor and fail with ErrNotMinimal (wrapped "Gram: ...") when Dpotrf fails.
- policy.gramianInputs must map factor types to the base equation.
- Also: invalid GramType currently returns bare ErrDimensionMismatch with no "Gram:" prefix -> should be fmt.Errorf("Gram: unknown type %d: %w", typ, ErrInvalidArgument).
- n==0 empty X: follow whatever W7OUGJ settles for n==0 matrix results.
- Document GramType/GramResult.

Related: K5MF76 also covers the bad-GramType sentinel.

Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit).

1. minimal.go:29-136 Reduce: opts.Mode outside {ReduceAll, ReduceUncontrollable, ReduceUnobservable} skips both staircase branches and returns the full model as "reduced", nil error.
   Repro (confirmed): s.Reduce(&ReduceOpts{Mode: ReduceMode(7)}) -> err=nil, Order=2 (unchanged).
   Fix: validate Mode up front -> fmt.Errorf("Reduce: unknown mode %d: %w", mode, ErrInvalidArgument). Also validate Tol (negative/NaN) before the n==0 early return so validation does not depend on model order.
2. minimal.go ReduceResult.BlockSizes: populated only for ReduceAll/ReduceUncontrollable with n>0, m>0; nil for n==0 / m==0 / p==0 and zeroOrderResult paths; [] (empty) for ReduceUnobservable. Same field means "staircase block sizes" or "not computed". Either always compute (empty slice only when the controllable part is truly empty) or drop the field from the default result and make it an opt-in request. Document.
3. modal_reduction.go:40-46 ModalTruncate: n==0 returns before opts.Order is validated, so Order:5 on a static gain succeeds (confirmed: err=nil). Validate options before the n==0 shortcut (Order must be 0 or <= n).
4. modal_reduction.go:45, 62: bare ErrInvalidOrder without "ModalTruncate:" context (confirmed message "controlsys: reduction order out of range").
5. Gram bad GramType -> bare ErrDimensionMismatch is covered in the Gram task (Q3KILR).

Related: Q46BFU (group 1 unvalidated enum args) - same class; merge at triage.

Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit). Same pattern as W7OUGJ (Care/Dare/Lqr/Lqe); apply whatever W7OUGJ decides consistently here.

- lyapunov.go:83-85 Lyap and 162-164 DLyap: n==0 -> &mat.Dense{} (gonum's empty, unusable: most mat ops panic on it) with nil error. matrix_equation_problem.go:81-83 lyapunovProblem n==0 shortcut feeds this.
- gramian.go:45-47 Gram: n==0 -> GramResult{X: &mat.Dense{}} (L nil; see Q3KILR).
- modal_reduction.go:41-43 ModalTruncate: n==0 -> Basis/Projection &mat.Dense{}, Kept/KeptPoles nil.
- matlog.go:16-18 / matlog_spectral.go:26-28 (internal) return 0x0 for n==0 (consistent once decided).

Decide one convention (sentinel error such as ErrInvalidArgument "no states", or documented empty-result contract) and apply across these entry points with doc comments stating it. Not filed: HSV n==0 returning a nil []float64 (zero states -> zero HSVs is a valid full value).

Related: OZU352 (group 1 n==0 placeholders) and W7OUGJ - decide one convention.

Auditor 3 (Go idiom audit).

Root cause: frequency_svd.go:100-124 complexSVDWorkspace.singularValues (and singularValuesFromFlat/Nested) has no error return. At a pole (an Inf response entry) it writes sigma_1=+Inf and NaN for sigma_2..; when Dsyev fails it writes NaN for every value. Both are placeholders meaning "unknown", returned with nil error.

Reaches public API:
- System.Sigma (frequency.go:875-882 via sampled_response.go:58-64).
  Repro (confirmed): 2x2 A=[0 1;-1 0], B=C=I, D=0; sys.Sigma([]float64{1}, 0) -> err=nil, At(0,0)=+Inf, At(0,1)=NaN.
- FRD peak gain (frd.go:325-335) compares sv[0] > gain, silently skipping NaN.
- sigmaMaxPointwise (norms.go:655-679) needs explicit NaN special-casing.

Fix options:
- Give singularValues an error return; Dsyev failure -> ErrSchurFailed (wrapped with op context); callers propagate.
- At a pole: return all singular values that are determinable; MATLAB sigma at an exact pole reports Inf for the gain - decide whether all sigma_i become +Inf or Sigma returns an error for that grid point (e.g. ErrSingularTransform "frequency hits a pole"). Either way no NaN in a nil-error result.
- maximumFromFlat's (float64, bool) is internal ok-idiom; fold it into the error-returning form for consistency.

Related: PIVD5W covers Sigma/FRD empty-omega placeholders; this task is the at-pole/Dsyev NaN case.

data.title: Error hygiene in group-1 files: capitalization, double prefixes, unwrapped errors, wrong sentinels
data.body:
Audit group 1. Checklist cat 2. Static only.

Capitalized error strings (staticcheck ST1005): conversion_options.go:53 "Tustin scaling overflows", :77 "Thiran order requires ...", conversion_thiran.go:34 "Thiran coefficients overflow".

Double "controlsys:" prefix (sentinel already carries it): canon.go:202 "controlsys: Schur decomposition failed: %w" + ErrSchurFailed -> "controlsys: Schur decomposition failed: controlsys: Schur decomposition failed to converge"; canon.go:156/163/314/320/326/334/340 "controlsys: ...: %w" around ErrSingularTransform.

fmt.Errorf without a sentinel (errors.Is impossible):
- connect.go Feedback "feedback: plant cannot be nil", "feedback: plant must be square ..." (wrap ErrInvalidArgument / ErrDimensionMismatch); Connect "connect: system cannot be nil".
- canon.go:41 "unknown canonical form" (ErrInvalidArgument), :73 "eigendecomposition failed", :115 "complex eigenvalue without conjugate pair" (ErrConjugatePairs), :148 "eigenvector matrix ill-conditioned" (internal, but still).

Wrong/misleading sentinels: controller.go:312 Place SVD failure -> ErrSchurFailed; controller.go:417 placeSchur "no 2x2 block" -> ErrSchurFailed; balance.go Modred bad elim index -> ErrInvalidOrder; conversion_delay.go:412/669 discretize default branch -> bare ErrInvalidConversionOptions.

Inconsistent op prefixes: mixture of "Balreal:", "feedback:", "series:", "blkdiag:", "connect:", "controlsys:", "D2C zoh:", "DiscretizeMatched:", none at all. Bare sentinels with no op context: Balreal ErrUnstable/ErrNotMinimal, Place/Acker ErrPoleCount/ErrPoleMultiplicity/ErrNotSISO/ErrDimensionMismatch, Lqrd all ErrDimensionMismatch, DiscretizeImpulse ErrWrongDomain (convert.go:401) vs "DiscretizeZOH: system already discrete: %w" elsewhere, d2cMatched ErrInvalidSampleTime/ErrDescriptorUnsupported, DiscretizeLeastSquares ErrInvalidSampleTime/ErrNotSISO/ErrInvalidOrder, discretizeDelayedChannels ErrFeedbackDelay/ErrDimensionMismatch.
Proposal: one convention "<ExportedOp>: <detail>: %w" with the exported Go function name (matches Lqi), applied across these files; lowercase detail.

Docs (cat 7) for this unit: ErrInvalidConversionOptions (conversion_options.go:9) undocumented; AlgebraicLoopError.Error/Unwrap undocumented (minor).

data.title: RootLocus: wrong branches for descriptor E, silently ignores delays, panics on static gain, placeholder Breakaway/centroid
data.body:
Correctness + checklist 1/3/7. rlocus.go.

- rlocus.go:51-80 builds A - K*B*C, ignoring sys.E. Repro: NewDescriptor(A=-1,B=1,C=1,D=0,E=2); RootLocus(sys,[]float64{0}).Branches[0][0] = -1, correct pole -0.5. Fix: generalized eig of (A-KBC, E), or ToExplicit for nonsingular E and reject singular E.
- I/O and internal delays ignored silently: sys.InputDelay=[1] -> err=nil, delay-free locus. MATLAB rlocus rejects continuous delays (use pade). Fix: ErrDelayUnsupported unless delay-free (discrete: AbsorbDelay first).
- Static gain panics: RootLocus(NewGain([[0]]),nil) -> PANIC "mat: zero length in matrix dimension" (line 73). Fix: n==0 -> error.
- RootLocus(sys, []float64{}) returns Branches=[] err=nil. Empty non-nil gains -> ErrInvalidArgument (nil = default grid OK). NaN/Inf gains unchecked.
- computeBreakaway (212-246) swallows rationalTransferFunction/Roots errors and returns nil, so Breakaway nil means both "none" and "failed". Propagate the error.
- AsymptoteCentroid = 0 placeholder when nPoles==nZeros (code-read, 89-106): 0 is a valid centroid value. Return centroid only alongside angles (e.g. Asymptotes slice of {Angle, Centroid}) so absence is an empty slice, not a 0 placeholder.
- D != 0 rejected with ErrDimensionMismatch (line 30): wrong sentinel (ErrOptionUnsupported) — MATLAB rlocus accepts D.
- line 76 bare ErrSchurFailed without "RootLocus:" prefix (and it is an Eigen failure).
- RootLocusResult and RootLocus lack doc comments.
MATLAB shape rlocus(sys,k) -> args already match.

data.title: H2Syn/HinfSyn silently ignore plant delays and never Validate P (partitionGeneralizedPlant)
data.body:
Correctness/checklist 1/2. synthesis_partition.go:14-58 (root cause); callers h2syn.go:22, hinfsyn.go:30.

partitionGeneralizedPlant reads A,B,C,D only; P.InputDelay/OutputDelay/Delay/LFT are dropped and P.Validate() is never called.
Repro: P = New(A=[-1 1;0 -2], B=I2, C=I2, D=[0 1;1 0], 0); r0 := H2Syn(P,1,1); P.InputDelay=[0,5]; r1 := H2Syn(P,1,1) -> err=nil and r1.K.A == r0.K.A (same controller for a plant with a 5 s actuator delay).
MATLAB h2syn/hinfsyn reject delayed plants.
Fix: call P.Validate(); return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", op, ErrDelayUnsupported) when P.HasDelay()||P.HasInternalDelay(). Also add op context to bare sentinels here: line 16 ErrWrongDomain, 24/27/35 ErrInvalidPartition, 70/78 ErrNotStabilizable/ErrNotDetectable, 101 ErrAlgebraicLoop (drops invertSmall cause), 141 ErrSchurFailed — pass the caller's op name in.

data.title: ControllabilityStaircase: no error return; panics on nil, accepts mismatched dims, returns partial staircase on SVD failure (feeds TransferFunction)
data.body:
Checklist 1/3/5. staircase.go:17-154.

`ControllabilityStaircase(A, B, C *mat.Dense, tol float64) *StaircaseResult` has no error return:
- nil A -> PANIC nil deref (line 18). Repro: ControllabilityStaircase(nil,nil,nil,0).
- A 2x2 with B 3x1 -> no error, NCont=2 (silently mismatched).
- svd.Factorize failure (81-84) `break`s and returns the partially reduced staircase as if complete. sys.TransferFunction consumes it (transfer.go:212), so a wrong TF with nil error is reachable from public API.
- tol<0/NaN unchecked (NaN -> rank 0 -> NCont 0).
- MATLAB ctrbf(A,B,C,tol) returns [Abar,Bbar,Cbar,T,k]; the result lacks T.
Fix: return (*StaircaseResult, error); validate dims (C optional -> document), tol; SVD failure -> error; add T. Check overlap with NP7RET (CtrbF/ObsvF) — if CtrbF is the MATLAB entry point, unexport this. Add doc comments (StaircaseResult, ControllabilityStaircase).

data.title: Docs + dead code in group-1 files (connect, canon, convert, controller_observer_policy)
data.body:
Audit group 1. Checklist cat 7 (docs) and cat 6 (idioms/dead code).

Missing doc comments on exported identifiers (each should start with its name and state error/edge behaviour):
- connect.go: Series (:45), Parallel (:200), Append (:504), BlkDiag (:1008; note len==0 error, single-system copy), Connect (:1232; Q is m×p, 0-based indices, inputs/outputs must be non-empty and unique).
- canon.go: CanonForm, CanonModal, CanonCompanion, CanonResult, Canon (modal = eig with Schur fallback, ascending |λ|; companion SISO only, unobservable -> ErrSingularTransform).
- balance.go / convert.go / conversion_result.go items are listed in 3ODSK6, QHJSRN, 53W2Z7.

Dead code (staticcheck U1000): connect.go:217 totalDelayMatrix; controller_observer_policy.go:38 controllerObserverPolicy.regulator, :45 estimator.
Small idiom nits: conversion_delay.go:604-605 `er, k0r, k1r := fohKernel(...); _ = er` (use `_, k0r, k1r :=`); conversion_thiran.go:178-180 redundant `if err != nil` after already-checked err; conversion_plan.go:104-115 switch mixes string literals ("zoh","tustin",...) with C2DMethod constants; convert_reverse_hold.go imports not grouped stdlib/third-party; balance.go/canon.go Balred/Modred/canon helpers keep inline "what" comments (e.g. "// Bb = Tinv * B", "// Build companion A") that restate code (user rule: comments only for counter-intuitive logic).
Not a behaviour change; go vet/staticcheck clean afterwards.

data.title: TransferFunc.StateSpace: swallowed NewGain error -> nil deref panic, Den=[0] -> +Inf D, empty TF -> 0x0 gain, dead MinimalTol option
data.body:
Checklist 1/2/3/5. transfer.go:584-753.

- Lines 601 and 627 `sys, _ := NewGain(...)` discard the error. validateShape does not check Dt, so TransferFunc{Num:[[[1]]],Den:[[1]],Dt:-1}.StateSpace(nil) -> PANIC nil pointer deref (sys.InputName on nil). Fix: validate Dt (newTimeDomain(tf.Dt).validateSampleTime) up front and propagate NewGain errors.
- Static rows divide by tf.Den[i][0] without a zero check (619-626, 652-656): Den=[[0]] -> D=+Inf, err=nil. The dynamic path returns ErrSingularDenom for the same condition (662). Fix: ErrSingularDenom for |Den[i][0]| < smlnum in all paths (better: in validateTransferChannelShape).
- p==0 path (600-605) returns a 0x0 static gain (Dims 0,0,0) with nil error and drops tf.Delay. Per the error rule/6K4CVZ pattern, an empty TF should be an error (ErrDimensionMismatch).
- StateSpaceOpts.MinimalTol (585) is never read anywhere — callers setting it get silently ignored behaviour. Remove it or implement minreal tolerance (MATLAB ss(tf) is non-minimal; minreal(sys,tol) separate).
- Errors lack op prefix: 608 bare ErrImproperTF, 663/674/686/690 "row %d: %w".
- StateSpaceOpts, StateSpaceResult, (*TransferFunc).StateSpace lack doc comments; BlockSizes semantics undocumented (nil on p==0 path, degrees on static path).

data.title: TransferFunc.Eval/EvalMulti/Isproper and ZPK.Eval/FreqResponse panic on malformed models (no validation, no error return)
data.body:
Checklist 3/5. transfer.go:53-107, 848-860; zpk.go:109-148.

TransferFunc and ZPK have exported mutable fields, but these methods index them without validateShape:
- TransferFunc{Num:[[[1],[1]]], Den:[[1,1],[1,2]]}.Eval(1i) -> PANIC index out of range [1] with length 1. EvalMulti, (*TransferFunc).Isproper same.
- (&ZPK{Gain:[[1]]}).FreqResponse([]float64{1}) -> PANIC index out of range (Zeros nil). ZPK.Eval same.
- TF Eval silently rounds fractional discrete delays (math.Round(tau), line 67) instead of erroring (ErrFractionalDelay).
- ZPK.FreqResponse: bare ErrDimensionMismatch for empty omega (127), no NaN/negative omega check, never validates Dt.
Fix: Eval/EvalMulti/ZPK.Eval return ([][]complex128, error) after validateShape (MATLAB evalfr(sys,s) errors on invalid models); FreqResponse calls validateShape; Isproper -> (bool, error) or validate first. Doc comments missing for TransferFunc, Dims, Eval, EvalMulti, TransferFuncResult, ZPK, NewZPK, NewZPKMIMO, Dims, IsContinuous/IsDiscrete, Eval, FreqResponse, TransferFunction, (*TransferFunc).ZPK, ZPKModel, ZPKResult, StateSpace.

data.title: System.Isproper returns bool and maps internal failures to false; numericRank returns 0 on SVD failure
data.body:
Checklist 1/2/5. transfer.go:758-846.

(*System).Isproper() bool returns false when regularDescriptorShift fails (773), when F.SolveTo fails (785), when New(...) errors (793) or Reduce errors (797). "Improper" and "could not decide" are conflated (bool double-signalling a hidden error). numericRank (828-846) returns 0 when svd.Factorize fails, which Isproper then reads as a rank.
Also no Validate: nil E handled, but malformed sys panics.
Naming: Isproper vs IsStable/IsDescriptor/IsContinuous — inconsistent Go casing (MATLAB isproper). Both (*System).Isproper and (*TransferFunc).Isproper.
Fix: `func (sys *System) IsProper() (bool, error)` propagating failures (keep Isproper as deprecated alias if desired); numericRank returns (int, error). Callers (StateSpace path, Simulate/timeResponseForm) adapt.

data.title: ZerosDetail returns Rank=0 placeholder for static gains / no-I/O models
data.body:
Checklist 1. zeros.go:39-43.

`if n == 0 || m == 0 || p == 0 { return &ZerosResult{}, nil }` — Rank 0 is wrong for a static gain: normal rank of [A-sE B; C D] with n=0 is rank(D). Repro: NewGain(I2,0).ZerosDetail() -> Rank=0, err=nil; MATLAB [z,nrank]=tzero(ss(eye(2))) gives nrank=2.
Fix: n==0 -> Rank = numeric rank of D (Zeros empty is valid). m==0 or p==0 with n>0: rank 0 is correct, zeros empty.
Also: ZerosDetail lacks doc comment; bare ErrSingularTransform at 154/190 without "Zeros:" prefix; zerosStaircase's err return is always nil (unnecessary).

data.title: Simulate: Response.Y nil with nil error when p==0 or zero steps (XFinal opt-in handled by PR #241)
data.body:
Checklist 1. simulate.go:36-74, 188-205, 288-290, 404-406.

Response.Y is nil with nil error when the model has no outputs (p==0) or there are zero samples (u nil and opts.Steps==0). Repros (origin/main):
- New(A=0.5,B=1,C=nil,D=nil,0.1).Simulate(u 1x3, nil, nil) -> Y=nil, err=nil.
- Discrete SISO .Simulate(nil, nil, nil) -> Y=nil, err=nil.
PR #241 makes XFinal opt-in (SimulateOpts.FinalState, errors when unavailable) and its p==0 path returns &Response{} (Y nil) when FinalState is false — so after #241 a p==0 call without FinalState returns an all-nil Response with nil error.
Fix (sequence after #241 merges; XFinal values under delay are SEWANW/#241, not this task):
- zero samples -> ErrInsufficientData ("Simulate: no samples"), MATLAB lsim requires t.
- p==0 and !FinalState -> error (nothing requested is representable: gonum cannot hold a 0xN Y); p==0 with FinalState -> document Y as not requested or split into a state-only API. Triage decide the shape; never all-nil Response with nil error.
Also: line 38 bare ErrWrongDomain (no "Simulate:" prefix); validateSimulateSteps Steps<0 uses ErrDimensionMismatch (ErrInvalidArgument); Response/SimulateOpts lack doc comments.

data.title: Simulate: returned XFinal aliases caller's SimulateOpts.Workspace
data.body:
Checklist 4. simulate.go:207-245 (simulateNoDelay), unchanged by PR #241.

simulateNoDelay uses opts.Workspace as the swap buffer (`x, tmp = tmp, x`), so after an odd number of steps the returned Response.XFinal *is* the caller's Workspace vector. Repro: discrete SISO, ws := NewVecDense(1,nil); r,_ := sys.Simulate(u 1x1, nil, &SimulateOpts{Workspace: ws}) -> r.XFinal == ws (pointer-equal). Reusing ws for the next Simulate call (its documented purpose) overwrites the previous result's XFinal; after an even step count XFinal is fresh, so the aliasing is step-parity dependent.
Fix: copy into a fresh XFinal at the end when x aliases Workspace (or use Workspace only as scratch and always return the non-workspace buffer). Document that Workspace is scratch only. Add a test: two consecutive Simulate calls sharing Workspace keep the first XFinal intact.

data.title: ERA returns NaN model with nil error when order exceeds numerical rank; SVD failure without sentinel
data.body:
Checklist 1/2. sysid.go:22-129.

- order is checked against len(sigma) (65), not the numerical rank; zero/tiny singular values give snHalfInv = 1/sqrt(0) = Inf (83) and NaN A/B/C. Repro: markov = [1, 0, 0, 0, 0] (1x1), ERA(markov,1,1) -> Sys.A = [NaN], err=nil. Fix: compute rank with tolerance (max(dims)*eps*sigma[0]) and return ErrInvalidOrder ("order %d exceeds Hankel rank %d") — the message already says rank.
- 58: fmt.Errorf("ERA: SVD failed to converge") without a sentinel (use %w with ErrSingularTransform or a convergence sentinel).
- validateMarkovSignalSequence (sampled_signal.go:100-135) hardcodes "ERA:" prefixes and checks dt<=0, letting NaN dt through until New() rejects it after all the work.
MATLAB: era is in System Identification Toolbox as era(data, nx) — args (markov, order, dt) acceptable.

data.title: Sampled-signal validation accepts NaN/Inf dt (FreqRespEst returns Dt=NaN); bare sentinels without context
data.body:
Checklist 1/2. sampled_signal.go:28-68, 100-135; sampled_data.go.

validateSampledSignalPair checks `dt <= 0` (48), so dt=NaN/+Inf pass. Repro: FreqRespEst(u 1x64, y 1x64, math.NaN(), nil) -> err=nil, result Dt=NaN, Omega all NaN. validateMarkovSignalSequence (107) same pattern.
Fix: use newTimeDomain(dt).validateSampleTime() plus dt>0 (discrete required) everywhere; wrap with context.
Bare sentinels without op prefix even though `context` is passed in: 30 and 42 ErrInsufficientData, 49 ErrInvalidSampleTime, 52 ErrInsufficientData. Use fmt.Errorf("%s: ...: %w", context, ...).

data.title: SumBlk panics on width<=0 and silently truncates mismatched signal widths
data.body:
Checklist 3/1. sumblk.go:255-342.

- applyWidths (255-275) never checks widths > 0. SumBlk("e = r - y", 0) -> PANIC "mat: zero length in matrix dimension"; SumBlk("e = r - y", -1) -> PANIC "mat: negative dimension".
- directMatrix (298-305) uses diag = min(wIn, w) when signals in one equation have different widths, silently producing a partial sum. Repro: SumBlk("e = r - y", 2, 3, 1) -> err=nil, D = [1 0 0 -1; 0 1 0 0] (r(3) dropped, y only feeds e(1)). MATLAB sumblk requires all signals in a sum to have the same size.
Fix: widths must be >= 1 (ErrInvalidArgument); per equation require width(output) == width(each input) else ErrDimensionMismatch with the signal names.
Also: SumBlk lacks a doc comment (MATLAB sumblk(formula, signalsize) — scalar width matches; per-signal widths are an extension worth documenting); parser errors print tokenKind as %d ("expected 1"), and parseTerm/parseEquation discard the inner err when re-wrapping.

data.title: FixedInputReduction panics (makeslice cap out of range) when len(fixed) > m
data.body:
Checklist 3. state_space_utils.go:100.

`keep := make([]int, 0, m-len(fixed))` runs before index validation; with more fixed entries than inputs the capacity is negative. Repro: SISO sys; sys.FixedInputReduction(map[int]float64{0:1, 5:2}, "o") -> PANIC "makeslice: cap out of range". Expected: "input index 5 out of range" error.
Fix: validate indices first (loop at 102-107) and size keep with max(m-len(fixed),0) or after validation. Also nil sys uses ErrDimensionMismatch (94) — see group-5 sentinel task.

data.title: SS2SS panics on nil T; n==0 ignores T dims
data.body:
Checklist 3. transform.go:14-30.

SS2SS(sys, nil) -> PANIC nil pointer dereference (T.Dims() at 21). For n==0 (static gain) any T, including wrong sizes, is accepted silently (17-19). MATLAB ss2ss errors on a T of the wrong size.
Fix: T == nil -> ErrInvalidArgument; check dims before the n==0 shortcut (accept only 0x0/empty T for n==0). Also neither SS2SS nor Xperm calls sys.Validate().

data.title: Validate ignores InputName/OutputName/StateName lengths (LFT panics); NewFromSlices accepts negative dims
data.body:
Checklist 3/1. ss.go:74-107, 293-340; panic site signal_metadata.go:80-89.

- Validate never checks name slice lengths. Downstream code slices them assuming length m/p/n: LFT(M with InputName=[]string{} (non-nil, len 0), Delta, 1, 1) -> PANIC "slice bounds out of range [:1] with capacity 0" in lftVisibleMetadata. Xperm (transform.go:106) silently skips permuting a mismatched StateName and returns it unchanged (3 names for n=1).
  Fix: Validate requires each non-nil name slice to have length m/p/n (ErrDimensionMismatch); lftVisibleMetadata guards with len().
- NewFromSlices(-1, 1, 1, nil, nil, nil, []float64{3}, 0) -> err=nil, Dims (0,1,1): negative n/m/p silently become 0. Fix: n,m,p < 0 -> ErrInvalidArgument.
- Validate on nil sys returns "system is nil: dimension mismatch" (76) — wrong sentinel/no prefix (see group-5 sentinel task); validateDims messages capitalized/unprefixed (staticcheck ST1005 at 198-228, 281).
- Missing doc comments: IsDescriptor, Dims, IsContinuous, IsDiscrete, Validate, NewGain, NewFromSlices, Copy, LFTDelay fields.

data.title: DescriptorE returns nil to mean identity E
data.body:
Checklist 1. state_space_utils.go:36-41.

(*System).DescriptorE() returns copyDescriptorE(sys.E), i.e. nil for explicit models (and for a nil receiver) — nil is a placeholder meaning "identity". Repro: New(...).DescriptorE() == nil. MATLAB dssdata returns E = eye(n) for explicit models.
Fix: return eye(n) for explicit models (empty for n==0 is the only empty case); drop the nil-receiver branch (nil receiver should panic like other methods or the method should return an error). Add doc comment; NewDescriptor, ToExplicit, EliminateStates, StateTransform also lack docs.

data.title: ThiranDelay: MATLAB thiran(tau,Ts) has no order argument; order range error uses ErrDimensionMismatch
data.body:
Checklist 5/2. thiran.go:19-81.

- ThiranDelay(tau, order, dt) requires an explicit order and returns ErrFractionalDelay when tau/dt <= order-1. MATLAB thiran(tau, Ts) chooses N = ceil(tau/Ts) automatically (always stable). User rule: args should match MATLAB.
  Proposed: public `ThiranDelay(tau, dt float64) (*System, error)` with MATLAB's automatic order; keep the fixed-order filter as an unexported helper for the internal caller delay_bank.go:110 (`ThiranDelay(samples*dt, thiranOrder, dt)` used by C2D Thiran banks), or expose fixed order via a functional option.
- 27: order out of 1..10 -> ErrDimensionMismatch; should be ErrInvalidOrder or ErrInvalidArgument.
- 21/24: bare ErrNegativeDelay / ErrInvalidSampleTime without "ThiranDelay:" prefix; 77 Series error returned unwrapped.

data.title: SmithPredictor: nil args error without sentinel, padeOrder uses ErrDimensionMismatch, inputs never validated
data.body:
Checklist 2/7. smith.go:27-87.

- 29/32: fmt.Errorf("SmithPredictor: controller cannot be nil") with no %w — errors.Is impossible. Use ErrInvalidArgument.
- 44: padeOrder < 1 -> ErrDimensionMismatch; should be ErrInvalidOrder/ErrInvalidArgument.
- controller/model never Validate()d; existing model delays are silently overwritten by SetDelay (59-67) — document or reject delayed model input.
- No doc comment on SmithPredictor (no MATLAB counterpart; document the structure C/(1+C(G-G·e^{-sT}_pade))).

data.title: Tunable blocks: {0,0} bounds sentinel, NaN accepted, nil-receiver placeholder getters, unvalidated constructors (nil Kp -> silent 0 gain), nil-rng reseed gives identical samples
data.body:
Checklist 1/3/4/5/7. tunable.go (all), tuning.go:180-190.

- TunableBounds{0,0} means "unbounded" (26, 102, 113; parameterGrid tuning.go:182): placeholder zero value, and a parameter bounded to [0,0] cannot be expressed — NewTunableReal("k", 5, TunableBounds{0,0}) succeeds with value 5. MATLAB realp has Minimum=-Inf, Maximum=Inf defaults. Fix: unbounded = ±Inf (constructor default / NewTunableBounds), validate Lower<=Upper, no NaN.
- NaN value/bounds accepted: NewTunableReal("k", NaN, {-1,1}) -> err=nil (NaN comparisons false).
- Nil-receiver getters return placeholders: Name() "", Value() 0, Bounds() {} (37-56). NewTunablePID("c", nil, ki, nil, 0, 0).CurrentSystem() -> err=nil, Kp=Kd=0 silently (188 b.Kp.Value()). Meanwhile Sample on the same block errors (nil parameter) — inconsistent.
- NewTunableGain/NewTunablePID/NewTunableTF/NewTunableSS return no error: no nil/ragged/dt validation until CurrentSystem. Constructors should validate and return (*T, error).
- RandomSample(nil): each TunableReal builds rand.New(rand.NewSource(1)) (105-107), so every free parameter in a block gets the same fraction. Repro: gain with params a,b in [-1,1], RandomSample(nil) -> both 0.20932057595923914. Fix: require rng (error on nil) or seed once per block; prefer math/rand/v2.
- Wrong sentinel ErrDimensionMismatch for empty name, bound order, out-of-range value, nil parameter (24, 28, 31, 70, 82, 100, 117, 255, 392, 396) -> ErrInvalidArgument.
- FreeParameters returns the block's internal *TunableReal pointers (164-169, 224-229...): callers' SetValue/SetFixed mutate the block — document as intended or return copies.
- uniqueFreeTunableReals (tuning.go:165) duplicates uniqueFreeTunableMatrices (tunable.go:483).
- No doc comments on any exported identifier in tunable.go (TunableBounds, TunableReal + 8 methods, TunableGain/PID/TF/SS, constructors, methods).
MATLAB mapping: realp(name, value) + Minimum/Maximum/Free; tunableGain(name, ny, nu); tunablePID(name, type); tunableTF(name, Nz, Np); tunableSS(name, nx, ny, nu) — current constructors take full parameter matrices instead.

data.title: Systune/Looptune are aliases of GridTune with non-MATLAB args; no context.Context for up to 100k evaluations; Inf-initialised best can return nil Controller
data.body:
Checklist 1/5/7. tuning.go:9-118.

- Systune and Looptune (25-31) just call GridTune (Cartesian grid search). MATLAB systune(CL0, SoftReqs, HardReqs, opts) separates soft/hard goals; looptune(G0, C0, wc, Req1, ...) takes plant, controller and crossover band. Same names with different semantics/args mislead. Fix: drop the aliases (keep GridTune) or give them MATLAB-shaped signatures.
- GridTune evaluates up to MaxEvaluations=100_000 closed loops with no cancellation. Fix: GridTune(ctx context.Context, ...) checking ctx.Err() per evaluation (ss_identification.go already does this).
- best starts as &SystuneResult{Score: +Inf} (66) and is replaced only when score < best.Score; if every candidate scores NaN or +Inf, GridTune returns Controller=nil, ClosedLoop=nil, Parameters=nil with nil error (code-read; not reproduced with simple goals). Fix: error (e.g. ErrPIDTuningTargetUnattainable-like sentinel) when no finite candidate.
- A single candidate error aborts the whole search (e.g. Overshoot goal on an unstable grid point -> "StepInfoForSystem: model is unstable"; plant 1/(s-10), K in [0,1]); consider scoring as infeasible rather than aborting — document either way.
- Method is a free-form string ("cartesian-grid") — typed constant.
- Wrong sentinel ErrDimensionMismatch for nil model, non-tunable controller, no goals, no free parameters, grid too large (36-61) -> ErrInvalidArgument.
- SystuneOptions zero value OK, but GridPoints<0/MaxEvaluations<0 silently become defaults.
- No doc comments: SystuneOptions, SystuneResult, Systune, Looptune.

data.title: TuningGoal: exported panicking constructors without Must prefix, NaN limits accepted, Evaluate(any), Margin goal stores phase margin in Max
data.body:
Checklist 3/5/7. tuning_goal.go.

- NewTrackingGoal/NewRejectionGoal/NewSensitivityGoal/NewWeightedGainGoal/NewLoopShapeGoal/NewMarginGoal/NewPoleGoal/NewOvershootGoal (77-123) panic on invalid input: NewTrackingGoal("", 1) -> PANIC. Go convention: panicking constructors are MustXxx; or return (TuningGoal, error). MATLAB TuningGoal.Tracking(inputname, outputname, responsetime, maxerror), TuningGoal.Margins(location, gm, pm), TuningGoal.Poles(mindecay, mindamping, maxfreq), TuningGoal.Overshoot(in, out, maxpercent) — current args lack I/O channel names and differ in shape.
- NaN Max/Min accepted: NewTuningGoal({Name:"x", Type:Tracking, Max:NaN}) -> err=nil (49 uses <0 comparisons). Every evaluation then fails Pass with NaN violation.
- Evaluate(model any) (137, 164-186) takes an empty interface and type-switches over *System/*GeneralizedModel/*GeneralizedClosedLoop; define a small consumer interface or separate methods.
- NewMarginGoal stores min gain margin in Min and min phase margin in Max (110); evaluateMargin result Value = min(GM dB, PM deg) with Limit = PM (262) — mixed units in one field. Use dedicated fields (GainMarginDB, PhaseMarginDeg) in the spec/result.
- evaluatePole uses max real part for discrete models too (267-282) — for Dt>0 should use |z| (MATLAB TuningGoal.Poles uses decay rate mapped from z). Redundant len(poles)==0 branch.
- TuningGoalType has no String(); errors print %d.
- firstAnalysisPointName (216) iterates a map — nondeterministic if ever reached (currently only for a zero-value GeneralizedClosedLoop).
- Wrong sentinel ErrDimensionMismatch throughout NewTuningGoal/validateTuningGoalFrequencyGrid/evaluateSystem/tuningGoalSystem -> ErrInvalidArgument.
- No doc comments: TuningGoalType + constants, TuningGoalSpec (field semantics per type!), TuningGoal, TuningGoalResult, NewTuningGoal, Name, Evaluate.

data.title: IdentifyIOStateSpace: errors without sentinels, stringly-typed options/status, failed candidates as zero-filled records
data.body:
Checklist 1/2/5/7. ss_identification.go.

- Every validation error (62-118, 138) is fmt.Errorf without %w — callers cannot errors.Is. Use ErrInsufficientData/ErrInvalidSampleTime/ErrInvalidOrder/ErrInvalidArgument (or ErrProcessData/ErrProcessExcitation from process_identification.go).
- InitialCondition ("zero"/"estimate"), ValidationInitialCondition ("continuation"/"zero"/"estimate"), Convergence ("converged"/"stationary"/"failed"/"evaluation_or_iteration_limit") are free strings; use typed constants (keep JSON via MarshalText).
- Failed candidates are returned in Candidates with Failure string set and zero placeholders (ValidationNRMSE 0, System nil, Stable false); the underlying error chain is flattened with err.Error() (212, 221, 227, 254, 287, 292). Under the error rule a candidate should be either a fitted model or carry a real error (e.g. Err error `json:"-"` plus string for JSON), not zero metrics that look like a perfect fit.
- No doc comments on IdentifyIOStateSpace, IOStateSpaceCandidate, IOStateSpaceResult.
- MATLAB shape: ssest(data, nx, 'InputDelay', nk, 'Feedthrough', tf) / arx; current (ctx, trainU, trainY, validationU, validationY, dt, options) — fine to keep the options struct but document the mapping.

data.title: Group 5 residual: ErrDimensionMismatch for nil/invalid args, bare unprefixed sentinels, missing docs (ss/state_space_utils/zpk/time_domain/sminreal/ssbal/stabsep)
data.body:
Checklist 2/7. Items not already covered by the per-function group-5 tasks (see epic). Same pattern as K5MF76/OHCIZR/PK5EOP for other groups.

Wrong sentinel (ErrDimensionMismatch for non-dimension problems -> ErrInvalidArgument):
- ss.go:76 Validate nil system; ss.go:281 NewGain nil D.
- state_space_utils.go:45 ToExplicit nil, :94 FixedInputReduction nil, :104 index out of range (ErrInvalidArgument or keep), :223 AugmentInternalDelayOutputs nil.
- simulate.go:146 Steps < 0.
Bare sentinels / no op prefix:
- time_domain.go:38 ensureCompatible returns bare ErrDomainMismatch (callers lose op name).
- zpk.go:57, 61, 64, 68 NewZPKMIMO return bare ErrDimensionMismatch with no detail; zpk.go:127 FreqResponse bare.
- ss.go:198-228 validateDims messages are capitalized and unprefixed (staticcheck ST1005) — callers New/NewDescriptor/Validate return them as-is; prefix with op ("New: A must be square ...").
- sumblk.go uses "sumblk:" prefix for exported SumBlk (others use the exported name).
Missing doc comments: Sminreal (sminreal.go:5, MATLAB sminreal), SsbalResult (ssbal.go:9), StabsepResult (stabsep.go:3), ERAResult ok.
Fix mechanically; update tests asserting errors.Is(ErrDimensionMismatch) on these paths.
